notes: Recorded from the live GitHub platform with scripts/check-platform-state.sh --record. scripts/check-platform-state.sh re-reads the platform and fails closed on any difference, so this file is the recorded half of the posture that git cannot show (M7, releases/PLAN-0.6.8.md:161-166).

Why it exists (W7, CT-80): at the audited tag 81f58ec no job declared an environment at all, so no MAC_* or GPG_* name could resolve there, yet the 2026-10-07 candidate runs signed and notarized. The wiring that made publication work was in no revision a reviewer could read. Current main declares environment: apple-signing on the macOS job and environment: release-signing on the publish job.

apple-signing and release-signing each carry a branch policy of main, zero required reviewers and can_admins_bypass true. What the platform requires before a signing job runs is therefore that the ref be main -- not that a human approve the run. Recorded as measured, not as preferred.
github-pages is not a signing environment: it deploys the Pages site and holds no secret. Its branch policies are recorded because the platform has them.

.github/workflows/build-linux.yml and build-windows.yml are registered but disabled_manually: they are the retired per-platform publishers that scripts/check-publish-paths.sh also treats as superseded. Re-enabling one is drift here.

allowed_actions is "all" and sha_pinning_required is false: the platform does not enforce action pinning. The workflow pins action SHAs by convention and tests/test_workflow_config.py holds that; the platform-level setting is an owner decision named on the next-cycle list in releases/PLAN-0.6.8.md section 9.
required_reviewers counts protection rules of type required_reviewers on the environment. Zero means a job that names the environment proceeds without an approval step.

apple-signing.MAC_NOTARY_KEY_P8_BASE64: referenced by the workflow and declared nowhere on purpose. Provide notary credentials (.github/workflows/build-candidate.yml:273-309) takes either an App Store Connect API key -- this secret plus vars.MAC_NOTARY_KEY_ID and vars.MAC_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID, neither of which is set on this platform -- or an Apple ID with an app-specific password (vars.MAC_APPLE_ID, vars.MAC_TEAM_ID and the declared secret MAC_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD). This platform uses the second route, which needs no Apple Admin role. tests/test_platform_state.py proves the fallback branch is present rather than trusting this note.

values: names only: no secret and no variable value is recorded. Secret values are unreadable through the API; variable values are deliberately not copied so this record can be published and reviewed.

.github/workflows/build-candidate.yml.name: Build all platform artifacts and release

.github/workflows/linux-inputs.yml.name: Produce the reviewed Linux build inputs
